A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same research work with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D. All content can be matched despite relocation of the bibliography and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original WordNet experiments on attribute recovery, partial-order inference, and concept meet/join retrieval in Section 4, Tables 1–3, and Figure 4.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical outcomes for attribute recovery, partial-order inference, and concept algebra, including the numerical comparisons in Tables 1–2 and Figure 4.

M1.justification: The half-space framework, soft inclusion scores, meet/join projection profiles, LDA attribute-direction estimation, and threshold procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same five WordNet domains—Animal, Plant, Food, Event, and Cognition—and the same attribute-recovery, subsumption, and concept-algebra tasks.

E2.justification: Random and Mean remain the comparison methods in Tables 1–2 and the concept-algebra evaluation in Figure 4. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: The model configurations, dataset counts, embedding procedures, precision/recall/F1 and MRR metrics, and sampling of 200 concept pairs per domain are unchanged.

E4.justification: The qualitative meet/join examples, physical-versus-abstract domain comparison, model-scaling analysis, and attribute PCA/correlation analyses are retained unchanged in Table 3, Section 4.4, and Figures 5–6.

E5.justification: Both retain the same statistical reporting practices. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The tables, plots, rankings, and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Gemma-7B retains 83.2% Animal F1 in Table 1, and LLaMA3.1-8B retains 77.1% Animal F1 in Table 2.

T1.justification: The definitions, lattice-existence theorem, canonical-representation proposition, equations, and proofs in Appendices B–C are identical after matching the relocated content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims connecting linear attribute geometry to FCA, defining embedding-based concept algebra, and providing WordNet evidence for latent lattice structure.

C2.justification: The interpretations of domain differences and model scaling, proposed neuro-symbolic applications, and limitations concerning nonlinear attributes and general-domain evaluation remain unchanged, including Appendix D.

D1.justification: GPT-4o annotation, synonym embedding aggregation, covariance estimation, and threshold details are unchanged. Both retain the same statement promising experimental code in supplementary materials.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The bibliography is relocated, with no additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 moves the bibliography from before Appendices A–D to after them, adds the ICLR 2026 publication header, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and appendix wording are unchanged.

P2.justification: The publication headers and back-matter layout change. Table 4 moves from page 15 to 13, and Figure 6 from page 16 to 14; all four tables and six figures retain their content, design, and captions.

improvement.justification: v2 changes publication labeling and back-matter ordering while preserving the methods, proofs, empirical evidence, explanations, and limitations. These limited presentation edits leave the paper's substantive support and overall clarity essentially unchanged.
